title: Rock Pools

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: When the tide goes out, it leaves little pools in the rocks, full of creatures!

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: We can take home empty shells and pretty pebbles. But anything alive goes back in the pool, where it lives.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Put the crabs back in the rock pool. Put the shells and pebbles in the bucket.
steps.hint: Is it alive? Then it goes back in the pool.

older.prompt: Anything alive goes back in the rock pool. Empty shells and pebbles go in the bucket.

feedback.mismatch: Hmm, is that one alive? Think again.
feedback.all_good: Every creature is home, and you've a bucket of treasures!

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Good sailor's manners: look, wonder, and leave every creature where it lives.

journal_line: I explored the rock pools with Captain Mara, and put every creature back.
